name: 3d-studio
description: Turns an image into a real, textured 3D relief model (GLB) locally, via a managed Python engine PaRuX installs on demand (Depth-Anything V2 + a displaced mesh). This is honestly draft-quality - one viewing angle's worth of real geometry, not a full 360-degree reconstruction - but works on any modern GPU, unlike heavier pipelines (e.g. TRELLIS) that need CUDA extensions pinned to older torch versions incompatible with newer GPU architectures.
author: PaRuX
